topic: Workable Radar 2026-09-19: remote inventory versus verified Japan eligibility
finding: At the 2026-09-18T22:34:55.026Z GWR Workable snapshot, 167,446 active jobs were observed, including 48,753 remote jobs, 566 jobs verified as Japan-eligible, and 739 Japanese-related jobs. The current snapshot also recorded 637 newly observed jobs and 820 confirmed closures since the previous snapshot.
data_scope: Global Work Radar ingestion of the public Workable XML feed. This is a Workable-market snapshot, not the entire global labor market.
general_user_value: Shows why 'remote' inventory and explicitly verified Japan eligibility must be read separately, while providing a fresh view of listing churn.
claim_limits: Do not present this Workable snapshot as representative of the entire global labor market.
Do not infer hiring probability, ease of hiring, applicant acceptance, or income from listing presence.
Do not equate remote with worldwide or Japan eligibility.
Do not interpret 637 new and 820 closed listings as net employment creation or destruction.
Do not turn the 739 Japanese-related listings into a population-level demand trend without a clean comparable baseline.
search_or_reader_signal: Japan-based readers need a current evidence-backed separation between remote listings and listings explicitly verified as Japan-eligible.
requested_followup_data: Continue comparable snapshots and only publish rate-of-change claims after baseline integrity is confirmed.
